text:
Maria CS: Kicking off quota-safety + warmup for Northward's Dedicated pool today. Goal: validate autoscale thresholds, priming scripts, and a safe traffic ramp to 60% of reserved QPS by EOD. @Raj Infra can you confirm GPU reservations and node labels?

Raj Infra: Confirmed — 8x A100s reserved in us-west-2, pool name northward-dedicated. Node labels `tier=reserved` applied. I set up an extra ephemeral node for soak.

Todd SRE: For autoscale, recommend start low with `min_replicas=2` and target CPU 60% (we'll use token-based queue depth on runtime). If latency spikes > 300ms at p95 we rollback. Also I'll add a temporary alert in PagerDuty.

Elaine ML: We'll run model priming passes to populate KV cache. Two parts: short prefix priming for common prompts, then full-context warmup for 2 min each model variant. I pushed a sample priming payload to the runbook.

Maria CS: Nice. Attaching the short checklist here. Please react when done :white_check_mark:
- Reserve pool + label ✅
- Autoscale settings pushed ✅
- Priming scripts staged ✅
- Load test plan approved ✅

Simon PM: Quick note on customer expectations — Northward wants <250ms median, <350ms p95 under 45% of committed QPS. They're ok with temporary degraded response beyond that during bake. Documenting in the rollout doc.

Katie SE: I'll run a small smoke using `loadgen-quick` then hand to Todd for the soak. Smoke commands: 
```
# smoke run (~5m)
loadgen --target https://northward.redwood/api/gen \
  --concurrency 10 --qps 50 --duration 5m --header "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>"
```
I'll post logs to the playbook.

Raj Infra: Autoscale policy pushed:
```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 16
  metrics:
    - type: queue_depth
      target: 200
    - type: cpu
      target: 60
```
Note: max_replicas aligns with reserved GPU count.

warmup-bot: priming job northward-priming-2026-03-21 started (job id: pj-9931). 16 shards, 90s per shard.

Todd SRE: Smoke results look clean. median=120ms, p95=260ms at qps=50. No OOMs. Moving to soak with ramp plan below.

Maria CS: Paste the ramp plan here so ops has it.

Todd SRE: Ramp plan:
- 5m @ 10% committed QPS (sanity)
- 10m @ 25% (observe caching behavior)
- 15m @ 40% (validate autoscale adds nodes)
- 20m @ 60% (target soak)
- 30m @ 60% steady (collect perf + errors)
If p95 > 350ms or error rate > 1% for more than 3 consecutive minutes, pause and rollback to previous model variant.

Elaine ML: I'll watch model latency regressions and KV hit-rate. If priming isn't effective we'll run an extra pass focusing on top-200 prompts.

Maria CS: I'm coordinating comms to Northward SRE and PM: telling them warmup + soak window starts in 30m. Any objections?

Simon PM: No objections. Call out that if anything goes wrong we'll fail closed to fallback model (smaller cheaper variant) and throttle external traffic.

Katie SE: One more thing — capture a short regression test set (10 prompts) and run every 15m, upload diffs to the thread. I'll start the first run now.

warmup-bot: soak job northward-soak-2026-03-21 queued (id: sj-4420). Expected end time +1h.

Raj Infra: I configured a temporary traffic-shed rule to protect infra: if total GPU util > 90% or queue depth > 800 then divert new requests to fallback cluster.

Todd SRE: Noted. PD alert created: `Northward Dedicated - High Latency` (threshold p95>350ms for 3m).

Maria CS: Thanks team. Please update this thread as you hit each checklist item. I'll ping Northward at the 15m mark with status. :rocket: 

Katie SE: First regression run attached (summary): 10/10 answers returned, mean latency 135ms, p95 280ms. No diffs of significance.

Elaine ML: KV hit-rate currently 78% after priming. If that doesn't improve by 10% during soak we'll extend warmup.

Todd SRE: Autoscale added 3 replicas at 40% ramp, GPU util peaked 68%, p95 stayed ~310ms. Continuing to 60%.

Maria CS: Pinged customer with interim note — they replied :+1: and asked for a short post-mortem doc after completion. We'll author a one-pager.

warmup-bot: soak job sj-4420 heartbeat: 25m elapsed, progress: steady, errors: 0.

Raj Infra: FYI I left a small tweak to the nginx proxy timeouts (120s->90s) to match runtime SLOs — rolled back if any issue.

Todd SRE: At 60% steady for 10m now. p95 trending 340ms, error rate 0.2%. Holding.

Maria CS: Great work. If we stay green for the remaining 20m I'll mark this as `onboard: ready-for-handoff` and schedule knowledge transfer with Northward's ops.

Simon PM: Add renewal ops note: warmup + smooth first 30 days reduces churn risk — log outcome in customer health dashboard.

Katie SE: Uploading final perf table and the 10-prompt diffs to the runbook now.

warmup-bot: soak job sj-4420 completed successfully. duration 1h02m, errors 0.

Maria CS: Closing this thread — handoff doc and post-mortem draft will follow in #docs-playbooks. Thanks everyone. :tada:
